getTs.title: Get TS
getTs.subtitle: Plan an XOR burn for a future TS claim.
getTs.claimNotice: TS is reserved for a future claim. Claims are planned for TONSWAP launch; no date is confirmed. Burning XOR is irreversible.
getTs.sourceTitle: How would you like to pay?
getTs.sourceDescription: Choose the funds you want to use. Every purchase, conversion, bridge, swap, and burn requires your approval.

card.title: Card
card.description: Buy ETH through MoonPay, convert to DAI, then bridge to SORA. Provider eligibility and fees apply.

ethereum.title: Ethereum
ethereum.description: Use supported funds on Ethereum mainnet, convert to DAI, then bridge to SORA.

ton.title: TON
ton.description: Use USDT on TON to check a conversion to Ethereum. Swap native TON to TON USDT first.

xor.title: I already have XOR on SORA
xor.description: Connect the SORA wallet that will own your future claim and review the burn.

sora.title: I have DAI on SORA
sora.description: Connect your SORA wallet and swap DAI to XOR before the burn.

getTs.walletsDescription: Your SORA wallet signs the burn and owns the future TS claim. Keep access to it.
getTs.ethereumPurpose: Use an Ethereum mainnet wallet you control. It holds your funds during conversion and transfer to SORA.
getTs.tonWalletLater: Connect your TON wallet in the next step when checking the conversion route.
getTs.googleAvailable: Google wallet is available in the SORA account chooser; a browser extension is optional.
getTs.recovery: Secure your wallet recovery information. Never give it to support or paste it into a payment provider.
getTs.walletsRequired: Connect the required wallets to continue.
getTs.mainnetRequired: Switch Polkaswap to SORA mainnet to use this campaign.
getTs.fundDescription: Check the available route and fees before moving funds. Keep enough ETH on Ethereum for conversion and bridge fees.
getTs.cardDescription: Your planned amount is carried into MoonPay. Review the provider’s final amount and use the Ethereum address below.
getTs.cardDestination: Ethereum receiving address — copy into MoonPay
getTs.cardDestinationNote: Use this Ethereum address at checkout. Your SORA claim wallet is a different address.
getTs.cardUnavailable: Card purchasing is not configured here. Choose another starting point or use your existing Ethereum funds.
getTs.cardEligibility: MoonPay checks your region, identity, payment method and limits. Its final quote may differ; keep ETH for later network fees.
getTs.cardQuoteRequired: A fresh acceptable liquidity check is required before opening the card purchase.
getTs.indicativeQuote: This liquidity check is indicative. Prices and liquidity may change before your later swap; it does not guarantee a future quote.
getTs.cardCompleted: MoonPay reports this purchase completed. Confirm the ETH in the receiving Ethereum wallet, then review the conversion to DAI below.
getTs.conversionReady: Your confirmed conversion received {asset}. Next, review the transfer to your SORA wallet.
getTs.conversionEth: ETH was received. Convert it to DAI on Ethereum before using the guided bridge.
getTs.bridgeDescription: Review the transfer amount, both wallets and network fees. Your plan is filled in for you.
getTs.bridgeReturn: Return here after the bridge. Continue when DAI appears in this SORA wallet; a balance does not prove which transaction funded it.
getTs.swapDescription: Your DAI amount is filled in. Review the latest quote and keep the reserved XOR for the burn fee.
getTs.swapFailed: The swap pair could not be prepared. Check the network and try again.
getTs.burnTitle: Review your burn and future TS claim
getTs.burnDescription: Check the final amount and claim estimate below. Burning destroys XOR permanently; TS is claimed later.
getTs.balancesDescription: Current spendable balances. These show readiness, not completed purchases or transfers.
getTs.balancesLoading: Balances are unavailable until the wallet is connected and synchronized.
getTs.noXor: Acquire XOR in this SORA wallet to continue. The burn also needs an XOR network fee.
getTs.noDai: Wait for DAI to arrive in this SORA wallet, or return to funding.
getTs.connectionFailed: Wallet connection was not completed. Try again when ready.
getTs.swapImpactBlocked: This route exceeds the {limit}% price-impact limit. Do not fund this amount until liquidity improves or a better route is available.
getTs.bridgePreparationError: This funding route could not be prepared. Check your network and wallet connection, then return to Get TS to try again.
getTs.tonRouteNotice: This route uses external apps and requires TON, Ethereum and SORA wallets. Review the steps before connecting.
getTs.cardRouteNotice: Your card buys ETH through MoonPay. You then convert and transfer funds to SORA before burning XOR.

routes.card: Card → ETH on Ethereum → DAI → transfer to SORA → XOR → burn for a future TS claim. Requires Ethereum and SORA wallets. MoonPay controls eligibility, identity checks, minimums and final fees.
routes.ethereum: ETH or USDT on Ethereum mainnet → DAI → transfer to SORA → XOR → burn for a future TS claim. Existing Ethereum DAI skips conversion. Keep ETH for network fees.
routes.ton: Native TON first needs an external TON-to-USDT swap. USDT on TON → ETH on Ethereum through Symbiosis → DAI → transfer to SORA → XOR → burn. The provider handles the TON transfer and its recovery. Keep TON and ETH for network fees.
routes.xor: XOR in your SORA wallet → review the burn → receive a future TS claim record. Keep XOR for the network fee.
routes.sora: DAI in your SORA wallet → XOR → review the burn → receive a future TS claim record. Swap and burn fees are included in the estimate.

getTs.separateReviews: You review and approve each transaction. Network confirmations and provider checks take time; each next action appears when it is ready.
getTs.initialEstimate: Initial estimate · refreshed before the burn
getTs.walletsIntroduction: Connect your payment wallet first. Your SORA account will own the future TS claim.
getTs.tonWalletPurpose: Use the TON mainnet wallet holding the TON or USDT you plan to spend.
getTs.tonEthereumPurpose: The current TON route sends ETH to an Ethereum mainnet wallet you control before transferring DAI to SORA.
getTs.createClaimWallet: Create or connect your claim wallet
getTs.googleExplanation: An encrypted backup is stored in your Google Drive. You still create wallet credentials and keep your recovery information.
getTs.useAnotherSoraWallet: I already have a SORA wallet
getTs.walletsReady: Your wallets are connected. Review the next action to continue.
getTs.alreadyHaveEth: I already have ETH — continue to conversion
getTs.existingEthereumDaiNote: You can skip conversion and review a transfer of your existing DAI.

bridgeProgress.unavailable: We cannot verify this transfer yet. Keep the same wallets connected and check your transfer history.
bridgeProgress.pending: Transfer submitted. Waiting for confirmation on SORA…
bridgeProgress.failed: The transfer needs attention. Open its history to review recovery or claim actions.

getTs.useExistingBalance: Use funds already in this wallet
getTs.existingBalanceNote: These are current balances. They do not confirm a particular purchase, transfer or swap.
getTs.swapSubmitted: Swap submitted. Waiting for its confirmation before continuing.
getTs.waitForXor: Waiting for spendable XOR in this SORA wallet.
getTs.cardPlanRequired: Return to your plan to check a supported purchase amount before opening MoonPay.

conversionProgress.pending: Conversion submitted. Waiting for Ethereum confirmation…
conversionProgress.received: DAI received on Ethereum. Review the transfer to SORA next.
conversionProgress.failed: The Ethereum conversion failed. Review the transaction before trying again.
conversionProgress.unavailable: We could not verify this conversion for the connected wallet. Check the transaction or try checking again.

swapProgress.pending: Swap submitted. Waiting for final confirmation…
swapProgress.received: Swap confirmed. Your XOR is ready for the burn review.
swapProgress.failed: The swap failed on chain. Review your wallet history before trying again.
swapProgress.unavailable: We cannot verify this swap yet. Check your wallet history before starting another transaction.

getTs.cardResumeDescription: You opened card checkout earlier. Check its status and the ETH in your receiving wallet before continuing or starting another purchase.
